name: brand-identity
body:
kalide has a documented visual identity, currently absent from the repo (no `logo/`/brand directory or brand SVG exists anywhere today). The brand board exists only as an image, so the SVGs are hand-authored recreations from it (close to the board, not a pixel-identical trace) following this written description, and the PNGs are rendered from those SVGs.

Mark: a regular hexagon outline drawn as a thick, uniform-width stroke with rounded/soft joins, in "the structure" `#F8F9FA`, on a "the void" `#0F1115` field. Inside, straight facet lines of the same stroke weight run between the hexagon's vertices and points on its edges, dividing the interior into irregular triangular facets (a faceted "gem"/crystal look; the board calls it "mathematical facets… beauty through rigidity"). One facet, a triangle whose base lies along the right-hand side of the hexagon and whose apex points left toward the centre, is solid-filled in "the enforcer" `#FF5722`; all other facets stay the background colour.

Wordmark: "kalide" in lowercase Inter, heavy/bold weight, in `#F8F9FA`, set to the right of the mark with its cap-height roughly matching the mark's middle band; outlined to paths (no `<text>`, no font dependency).

Lockups/exports: the mark alone (square, on `#0F1115`) exported at 512, 128, 32 and 16px; plus a horizontal lockup (mark + wordmark). At 16/32px the facet detail may be simplified, but the hexagon outline and the orange facet must stay legible.

Palette: "the void" `#0F1115`, "the structure" `#F8F9FA`, "the enforcer" `#FF5722`. The board's printed labels are slightly illegible (e.g. "#0F111S", "#PF5722"); these are the intended values.

It lives as plain repository files under the repo-root `brand/` directory, referenced only from documentation and marketing surfaces — README hero image, package-channel (Homebrew/Scoop) descriptions, an optional GitHub social-preview image — never embedded in the binary. The brand is all rights reserved, not Apache-2.0: `brand/LICENSE` reads "Copyright © Really Knows AI. All rights reserved." plus the statement that "kalide" and the kalide logo are trademarks of Really Knows AI and are not licensed under Apache-2.0. A repo-root `TRADEMARKS.md` gives a short permitted-use policy: anyone may refer to kalide by name and use the unmodified logo to link to or refer to the project; no one may use the name or logo for forks or derived products, use modified logos, or use them in a way implying endorsement.

AC: `brand/` holds committed hand-authored SVGs of the mark alone and of the horizontal lockup, following the mark/wordmark description above and using only the three palette colours; the wordmark is outlined to paths (no `<text>` element or font reference), so it renders without a system Inter install; the PNGs of the mark at 512/128/32/16px are exports of the committed mark SVG, and at 16/32px the hexagon outline and orange facet remain legible; `brand/LICENSE` exists with the all-rights-reserved and trademark statements; `TRADEMARKS.md` exists at the repo root with the permitted-use policy above; no file under `internal/assets` or any `go:embed` directive references the brand files.
